description: This file defines the Scriptlet class, which encapsulates a small script with a specified scripting language. It provides functionality to execute the script with a given context and to convert the scriptlet into a string representation.

classes.name: Scriptlet
classes.description: A class representing a scriptlet composed of a scripting language and script content, capable of execution and string representation.

methods.name: Scriptlet
methods.description: Constructor that parses a script string to extract the scripting language and script body.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Executes the scriptlet with the provided context and returns the result.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the scriptlet, combining language and script.
